review.switch_and_compile_scope: PASS STATIC: option NINFER_GGUF_Q4_MMQ_CHILD_CTA is default OFF; CMake rejects non-86 configured architectures and defines the runtime implementation macro only on ggml_mmq_q4_k.cu. Template parameters are defaulted false and loader I override defaults -1, preserving existing caller specialization behavior. Dispatch is constrained to Q4_K/J128/cc86/no ids_dst and falls back when Q4 async X/Y macros are enabled. It is reached only after the existing stream-K path selection.
review.mapping_and_fixup: PASS STATIC: child grid splits each existing logical I=128 tile into two physical I=64 CTAs while preserving the existing stream-K x partition. Child row offsets are applied to source loads and direct stores; fixup writes use the original logical J*I scratch layout and existing reducer. Row-bound checks use the baseline inclusive max-index convention.
review.test_binding_and_corpus: PASS STATIC: regression CLI requires both a weight directory and output path, calls public ops::linear with Q4_K, and requires two real fixture loads (N=17408 and 384 prefix) so synthetic fallback cannot satisfy the run. It covers T=1280/1281, full finite output, sampled CPU FP64 and independent Q8_1 oracle comparisons, graph/eager bitwise parity and output canaries. The 17408 fixture is used for both shapes; no repeated-row fixture is represented as real full-head data. Exact complete dump comparison against baseline remains an external qualification gate, not established by this static review.

finding.description: The new regression checks only that some CUDA device exists and that real fixtures/output paths were supplied. It does not require runtime compute capability 8.6, while dispatch in mmq.cuh:1817 is explicitly guarded by cc==86. Running the regression on another CUDA architecture can exercise the unchanged fallback and still report the child-CTA test as successful. CMake's architecture setting does not prove runtime device selection.
finding.suggested_resolution: Before accepting this test as candidate-route coverage, check the selected runtime device properties and return the test's skip code unless major/minor are 8/6, or bind a separate route receipt to the actual executed kernel.

review.compile_guard_findings: No other missing declarations or template-default regressions identified by source inspection; compile was intentionally not run.

validation.worktree_changes: six intended source files plus provenance manifest only

limitations: Static review only; no NVCC specialization/link/runtime evidence.
Candidate launch, occupancy, exact dump parity and full runtime dispatch are unverified.
The P2 runtime-architecture test gap should be closed before interpreting a regression pass as proof the child path ran.
